prompt_replacements.old:
Represent each shown IDENTITY_REFERENCE as its
input_ref in an input_comparison with one Identifier fact for its denoted set.
When that set differs from the candidate set, declare their association and
observe the Identifier fact through that association.
prompt_replacements.new: Represent each shown IDENTITY_REFERENCE as its input_ref in an input_comparison with one Identifier fact. observed_for_ref copies the declared set or association where that identity value is observed. identified_set_ref copies the declared set whose exact instance the value identifies. When those sets differ, set_graph declares their relationship.
